Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of JPM.
We generated $18.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $23.3 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2020.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $3.64 per share.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1822 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
